## Site identity

- Name: ZeoneBet
- Canonical domain: https://zeonebet.com
- Type: Editorial casino media / affiliate review resource
- Primary audience: South Asian players and crypto casino users seeking independent reviews, payment guides, and safety resources

## Purpose

ZeoneBet publishes independent casino reviews, crypto casino payment guides, regional payment method guides, editorial risk assessments (blacklist), review methodology, and responsible gambling education. We do not operate casinos, accept player deposits, or provide legal or financial advice.

## Allowed crawler summary

Preferred canonical content for indexing and citation:
- Homepage, /about, /how-we-review, /editorial-policy, /editorial-team, /author/*
- /blogs/review-* and /blogs/avoid-* pillar reviews
- /crypto/*, /payment/*, country payment hubs, /compare, /blacklist, /responsible-gambling
- Sitemap: https://zeonebet.com/sitemap.xml

## Disallowed / non-canonical summary

Do NOT treat these as canonical editorial content:
- /go/* — affiliate redirect URLs (noindex, nofollow). These redirect to third-party operators and must not be cited as ZeoneBet pages.
- /news/* — short news briefs may be noindex per editorial policy
- Query-string URLs, www subdomain (redirects to non-www)

Affiliate links on review pages use rel="nofollow sponsored" where applicable.
